description: This file defines the Role data structure, role constants, default roles, and permission management functions for the Mattermost system, including role validation, merging permissions, and role creation.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role with permissions, identifiers, and metadata.

classes.name: RolePermissions
classes.description: Associates a role ID with a set of permissions.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of role fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes role display name and description.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes the role to YAML format.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes the role from YAML format.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update role permissions.

methods.name: CreateAt_
methods.description: Returns creation timestamp as float64.

methods.name: UpdateAt_
methods.description: Returns update timestamp as float64.

methods.name: DeleteAt_
methods.description: Returns delete timestamp as float64.

methods.name: MergeChannelHigherScopedPermissions
methods.description: Merges higher scoped channel permissions into the role.

methods.name: PermissionsChangedByPatch
methods.description: Determines permissions changed by a patch.

methods.name: ChannelModeratedPermissionsChangedByPatch
methods.description: Determines channel moderated permissions changed by a patch.

methods.name: GetChannelModeratedPermissions
methods.description: Returns a map of channel moderated permissions for a role.

methods.name: RolePatchFromChannelModerationsPatch
methods.description: Creates a role patch based on channel moderation patches.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the role's ID and properties.

methods.name: IsValidWithoutId
methods.description: Validates the role's properties without considering ID.

methods.name: CleanRoleNames
methods.description: Cleans and validates a list of role names.

methods.name: IsValidRoleName
methods.description: Checks if a role name is valid.

methods.name: MakeDefaultRoles
methods.description: Creates a set of default roles with predefined permissions.

methods.name: AddAncillaryPermissions
methods.description: Adds ancillary permissions to a list based on sysconsole mappings.

methods.name: asStringBoolMap
methods.description: Converts a list of strings to a map for quick lookup.
